The mission loop

Plan the squad.
Build the mecha.

Make your decisions before the battle. Learn from each wave. Rebuild your strategy between encounters.

01 / ASSEMBLE

Give every part a purpose.

Spend parts and credits to manufacture seven specialist robot types. Balance scouts, guards, artillery, flame bots, snipers, repair bots, and shield bots before committing components to a fusion recipe.

02 / DEPLOY

Make positioning count.

Study the enemy preview and arrange robots on a 4 × 3 grid. Three waves per mission feature attack, overclock, or defense circuits; one has no circuit bonus. Placement bonuses lock in at battle start.

03 / DEFEND

Adapt between waves.

Watch robots move and fight automatically, and tap enemies for brief focus fire. Between waves, repair, upgrade, manufacture, equip temporary items, or dismantle ordinary robots to recover recipe parts.

Three robots. One decision.

Commit to a
different kind of power.

Each fusion consumes three living robots and creates a mecha with a 2 × 2 deployment footprint. The transformation cannot be undone.

GUARD + FLAME + SCOUT

BREACHER

A close-range striker with thermal blades. Its THERMAL CRESCENT skill delivers a heavy sweeping strike against enemies ahead.

ARTILLERY + SNIPER + SCOUT

LANCER

Long-range firepower built around an energy cannon. PIERCING LANCE sends a charged beam through enemies along its path.

GUARD + SHIELD + REPAIR

BASTION

An armored frontline unit. AEGIS PROTOCOL provides a protective barrier and repairs its own armor.

Energy builds during combat. When the bar fills, the mecha automatically releases its signature skill and begins charging again. Open ARCHIVE from the command center to study recipes, roles, skills, and alien backgrounds.

Mission support

Ready for
another wave?

Play offline, replay unlocked missions, and pursue a better star rating. Your mission progress and audio preferences are saved on your device.

Created by yunpeng for iPhone and iPad.

How do I learn fusion?

Mission 01 begins with a skippable cinematic and on-screen guidance. Choose GUARD or FLAME, build your squad, and follow the repair and manufacturing steps after wave 2 to assemble BREACHER for wave 3.

How do I start a battle?

Manufacture robots, then drag them from the bench onto the deployment grid. Deploy two robots for the first wave, or at least one for later waves, and select Start Battle.

Can I repair or change my squad?

Between waves, manufacture, repair, upgrade, sell, equip items, or reposition your units. Ordinary robots can be dismantled for recipe parts. Fusion permanently consumes its three living components and cannot be reversed with Undo Prep.

Does RIVYNTH need an account or internet?

No account or internet connection is needed to play. The current game has no third-party advertising or analytics SDKs.

Where is my progress stored?

Unlocked missions, best star ratings, and sound preferences are stored locally. Removing the app can remove that data. Device backups are controlled by your Apple settings.
